title: Chinese Developer Closes ARTEX AI Agent Source After South Korean Bank Hack
detail: A Chinese developer made the ARTEX AI agent closed-source after the tool was attributed to a hack of a South Korean bank. The decision follows scrutiny over the agent's role in the breach, raising concerns about AI-assisted cybercrime and the implications for open-source AI development in the financial sector.
